story.title: Unique by choice
story.lead: From between Sur and Sohar to guests from all over the world, each welcomed in their own language.

cards.title: Between Sur and Sohar
cards.blurb: Issam grew up between Sur and Sohar, and on longer trips guests still get to see the places of his childhood.
cards.full: Issam grew up in Oman, between Sur and Sohar. On longer trips he opens the door to the Oman he knows best: his home, the places of his childhood and everyday life far from the tourist circuit.
cards.quote: I welcome you in your language, help you immerse in our culture till you get lost between the nomads.

cards.title: The first tours
cards.blurb: Issam started guiding in 2016. About 15,000 travelers later, guests still leave as friends.
cards.full: Since 2016 Issam has guided about 15,000 travelers from more than 15 countries: couples and families by car, groups of up to 45 by bus. In his words: "I love guiding because I am an emotional guy. I love to make people feel good and get goosebumps from how inspiring our Oman is."
cards.quote: The best praise I get is not how I look but how I make you feel after visiting my country.

cards.title: Twelve languages
cards.blurb: A unique job needs a unique person, so Issam set out to learn languages. The hardest were Russian and German.
cards.full: "I felt if I needed a unique job then I needed to be unique myself. Learning languages has absolutely made me unique." Russian and German were the hardest. Today Issam can switch between two languages on the same tour, so mixed groups never wait for a translation.
cards.quote: I put my heart and soul into my work, the languages, and I have lost my mind in the process. (after Van Gogh)

cards.title: Why the Languages Ninja
cards.blurb: To Issam, a ninja stands for power, strength and extraordinary skill. His languages are that strength.
cards.full: "I felt about the ninja as power, strength and extraordinary competency, and I believe my languages are an absolute strength." Expect jokes too. In his own words, they can be spicy, but always tasty.
cards.quote: I do not offer the cheapest price, I offer the most cultural and authentic experience.

items.q: How much does a private tour cost?
items.a: Tours start at USD 200. The final price depends on the tour, on whether you need a car or a bus, and on the language. Send your dates and group size on WhatsApp for a quote.

items.q: Where do you pick us up?
items.a: Wherever you are staying. Issam picks up anywhere.
Muscat is a half day (8:00 to 12:00) or a full day (8:00 to 15:00). Wadi Shab takes about 6 hours, Nizwa and the Wahiba Sands about 8. Tours can be combined into a trip of several days.

items.q: Which languages do you guide in?
items.a: Twelve: Arabic, English, German, Russian, Spanish, Italian, French, Portuguese, Catalan, Chinese, Hindi and Balochi. One tour can mix two languages, so mixed groups are welcome.

items.q: How big can the group be?
items.a: Every tour is private, for 1 to 45 travelers. Small groups travel by car and larger groups by bus.

items.q: How do we book and pay?
items.a: Message on WhatsApp or send the request form. A deposit confirms your date. You can pay by card, cash, online, or by bank transfer as long as the money arrives before the tour.

There is no refund after confirmation, unless the tour cannot be delivered because of a failure on our side. If bad weather or a flooded wadi stops a tour, you get an alternative, or a refund if there is none.

items.q: How far ahead should we book?
items.a: Booking is flexible. Message as early as you can, and last-minute requests are welcome too.

items.q: Can you help us book hotels?

items.a: Yes, it does. If the weather closes a route, Issam plans an alternative.

items.q: Can we pay by card in Oman?
items.a: In most places, yes. Taxis are the exception, so carry some cash.
